description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named QuestionController that handles CRUD operations for the Question entity, using QuestionRepository for data access and handling HTTP requests at /questions endpoint.

classes.name: QuestionController
classes.description: Spring REST controller for managing Question entities, providing endpoints for listing, creating, updating, and deleting questions.

methods.name: getQuestions
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a paginated list of questions.

methods.name: createQuestion
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new question.

methods.name: updateQuestion
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing question identified by questionId.

methods.name: deleteQuestion
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a question identified by questionId.
